Discover

Discover Fundlet for your Organization

Find out how a Fundlet fundraiser works for the kind of group you run — from sports teams and bands to sororities, churches, scout troops, and volunteer fire departments.

A Fundlet fundraiser works the same way for every organization: a shop you partner with lists its products on a campaign page in your name, each of your members shares a personal link, supporters check out online, and every sale is credited to the member who made it. No order forms, no cash envelopes, and no spreadsheet at the end of the drive.

What changes is how a campaign fits your particular group — how your costs are assessed, whose name the money follows, which deadlines you are raising against, and what your treasurer has to be able to prove.

Pick the guide closest to your organization.

Sports and athletics

  • Fundraising for Sports Teams — Uniforms, tournament travel, and equipment, with every sale credited to the player who made it.
  • Fundraising for Youth Sports Leagues — One program across every team in the league, with per-team goals and per-player credit.
  • Fundraising for Cheer and Dance Teams — Choreography, competition fees, and nationals travel, tracked per athlete.

Schools and parent groups

  • Fundraising for Schools — A school-wide drive without the brochures, the envelopes, or a fundraising company's margin.
  • Fundraising for PTAs and PTOs — Fewer volunteer hours and clean books for the treasurer's report.
  • Fundraising for Booster Clubs — Every program you support, separately tracked, with records a district will accept.

Arts, music, and activities

  • Fundraising for Bands and Music Programs — Scales to a full marching band, with sections, feeder schools, and trip accounts.
  • Fundraising for Theater and Drama Programs — Money for rights and sets before the curtain, not after, and credit for crew as well as cast.
  • Fundraising for Robotics and STEM Teams — Registration, parts, and championship travel, with documentation sponsors ask for.

Sororities and fraternities

  • Fundraising for Sororities — Philanthropy participation measured per sister, with no one collecting from the chapter.
  • Fundraising for Fraternities — A drive that does not depend on event turnout, with per-brother records for your standards report.

Churches and faith organizations

  • Fundraising for Churches — Fund a specific project without passing a second plate.
  • Fundraising for Youth Groups — Camp and retreat costs, with earnings that follow the student.
  • Fundraising for Mission Trips — Per-traveler balances tracked automatically, as an alternative to the support letter.

Youth organizations

  • Fundraising for Scout Troops — The product drive you know, minus the order form, the cash box, and the sorting weekend.
  • Fundraising for 4-H Clubs and FFA Chapters — Project costs and convention travel, with reach past your county line.

Nonprofits and community groups

  • Fundraising for Nonprofits — An earned-revenue channel that does not compete with your annual appeal.
  • Fundraising for Animal Shelters and Rescues — Vet bills and foster supplies, with named campaigns for specific animals.
  • Fundraising for Fire Departments and First Responders — Equipment and benevolent funds, without a boot drive at an intersection.
  • Fundraising for Community Clubs and Associations — Rotary and Lions clubs, VFW and Legion posts, alumni associations, and neighborhood groups.

Not sure which fits?

The mechanics are identical for every group, so if none of these match exactly, start with the closest one — Fundraising for Nonprofits is the most general of the set. You can also see how Fundlet compares to traditional fundraising companies and donation platforms, or read the FAQ.

Book a free 30-minute consultation and we will help you plan your first campaign.

Are you a shop rather than an organization?

If you sell a physical product on Shopify or Square, you are the other half of this program — organizations sell your products to their community, and you gain customers who found you through a cause. Start with Discover Fundlet for your Shop for guides by what you sell, then install Fundlet on Shopify or open it on Square.
